mechanism.claim: Within a completed high-variation BTC block, unequal perpetual return transmission from positive versus negative spot-return minutes reveals directional derivatives amplification. Extreme downside amplification is continued short and extreme upside amplification is continued long.
mechanism.side: negative strict sign of log(down-spot transmission beta / up-spot transmission beta)
mechanism.why_distinct: HVPIAR compares one-venue return per quote turnover by return sign. HVCKIHR compares unconditional through-origin aggressive-flow impact between venues. HVSPER estimates error-correction adjustment loadings. HVSCTBA instead estimates two spot-conditioned cross-venue return transmission slopes and uses neither turnover, flow, basis, nor levels.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: directional transmission asymmetry is admitted only in the causal upper tail of completed perpetual path variation
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: Gross9 has no spot-sign-conditioned perpetual transmission primitive

features.block: 480 exact aligned coherent one-minute BTCUSDT spot and perpetual rows in [D-8h,D), with no missing or imputed row
features.minute_return: close-to-close log return within the aligned block; the first return uses the exact close at D-8h-1m from each venue
features.support: at least 120 strict-positive and 120 strict-negative spot-return minutes; both denominators and both transmission betas finite and strictly positive
features.asymmetry_rank: strict-prior midrank of abs(transmission_asymmetry) over at most 270 source-valid blocks, minimum 180, current excluded; rank>=0.80
features.variation: sqrt(sum squared completed perpetual minute returns)
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 270 source-valid blocks, minimum 180, current excluded; rank>=0.65
features.onset: the full asymmetry and variation rule is eligible now and was ineligible at the immediately prior exact source-valid boundary; missing prior cannot trigger

clock.reservation: natural global nonoverlap; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact settlements only after novelty

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

definitions.no_asymmetry_tail: transmission side plus variation and onset without tail rank
definitions.one_block_stale_asymmetry: prior block asymmetry with current variation

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

stopping_rule: terminal first failure; no venue, return, beta, sign support, rank, variation, onset, side, clock, hold, subset, threshold, comparator, or control repair
